naming_rule: {output_asset_id}_take{take:02d}.{extension}; use the first_take_filename supplied in each record
reference_rule: provides_reference_ids are stable input-reference groups; output_asset_id identifies one view or artifact; takes identify attempts. Existing IDs are never renamed when a take is accepted.
approval_rule: A planned filename is not an existing, attached or approved asset. Record accepted_path and selected_take only after inspection and acceptance. Media generated externally is not registered by this documentation change.
prompt_rule: Prompt .txt files remain model-only text. Read the adjacent README for output IDs and save-as filenames; never ask the model to draw identifiers on the image.
